# SKÖG® TOOLS

> SKÖG® TOOLS designs innovative tire inflation accessories, built around the patented Chuck Mates® quick-connect chuck family. All products are sold exclusively through Amazon; this site is the brand's product and story showcase.

SKÖG® TOOLS was founded by a commercial pilot and applies an aviation-reliability standard to everyday tire inflation tools. Products are designed in the USA and manufactured in Taiwan. Core technologies are RatchetSeal® (a locking, leak-free quick-connect used in the Platinum Series) and SimpleSeal™ (a Teflon-tape-free brass connection used in the Premium Series). Chuck Mates fit standard Schrader valve stems (designator 8V1, 0.305" - 32 TPI thread) found on cars, trucks, motorcycles, RVs, and bicycles.

## Products

- [Platinum Series](https://skogtools.com/platinum-series.html): Chuck Mates® with patented RatchetSeal quick-connect technology, plus Reach360/Flex360 extensions and SKÖG® NPT inflators for dual rear wheel (DRW) trucks and blind valve stems.
- [Premium Series](https://skogtools.com/premium-series.html): Chuck Mates® with SimpleSeal brass quick-connect technology, no Teflon tape required.
- [SKÖG® Adapters](https://skogtools.com/adapters.html): Locking brass NPT-to-Schrader adapters for air compressors.
- [SKÖG® Platinum Tire Gauge](https://skogtools.com/tire-gauge.html): Battery-free dual-needle tire pressure gauge, ANSI B40.1 accurate, with a RatchetSeal quick-connect chuck.
